task: You are a guest at a Toastmasters meeting. Someone at the door says the line below. Greet them and introduce yourself in two or three sentences.
say: Hi there, welcome! Is this your first time with us?
zh: 你是 Toastmasters 会议的嘉宾。门口有人对你说了下面这句话。和对方打招呼，用两三句话介绍自己。

task: At the end of the meeting, the president asks the guests for comments. Say what you enjoyed, and ask if you can come again next time.
say: We'd love to hear from our guests. What did you think of tonight's meeting?
zh: 会议结束时，主席请嘉宾发表感想。说说你喜欢的地方，并问下次能不能再来。

task: After a speech, it is your turn to speak. Thank the previous speaker in one sentence, then greet the audience before you begin.
zh: 一个演讲结束后轮到你发言。先用一句话感谢上一位演讲者，再向观众问好，然后开始。

task: The Toastmaster asks who can take a role at the next meeting. Volunteer for a role and say one sentence about why you want to try it.
say: We still need a Timer and a Grammarian for next week. Any volunteers?
zh: 主持人问谁能在下次会议担任角色。主动报名一个角色，并用一句话说明你为什么想试试。

task: You have just won Best Table Topics Speaker. Go to the front, accept the ribbon and say a short thank-you of two or three sentences.
say: And tonight's Best Table Topics Speaker is... you! Please come up.
zh: 你刚获得了最佳即兴演讲奖。走到前面接过奖带，说两三句简短的感谢话。

task: You are the Timer. At the start of the meeting, explain your role: what the green, yellow and red cards mean, and what you will do at the end.
zh: 你是计时员。在会议开始时解释你的职责：绿、黄、红卡分别代表什么，以及你在最后会做什么。

task: You are the Ah-Counter. At the start of the meeting, explain your role: what sounds and words you are listening for and why, and when you will give your report.
zh: 你是“口头禅统计员”（Ah-Counter）。在会议开始时解释你的职责：你会注意哪些声音和词、为什么，以及什么时候做报告。

task: Introduce the next speaker using the information below. Say the title, the project and the time, then lead the applause.
say: Speaker: Hannah Lee. Title: My First Marathon. Project: Ice Breaker. Time: four to six minutes.
zh: 用下面的信息介绍下一位演讲者。说出题目、项目和时长，然后带头鼓掌。

task: You are the Toastmaster of the evening. Introduce the Table Topics Master with one interesting fact about them, then hand over.
say: Table Topics Master: Daniel. He once cycled the length of New Zealand.
zh: 你是当晚的主持人。用一个关于他的有趣事实介绍即兴演讲主持人，然后把舞台交给他。

task: You are new to the club. Ask an experienced member to be your mentor for your first speech. Say why you are asking them and what help you need.
zh: 你是俱乐部的新会员。请一位有经验的会员在你的第一次演讲中当你的导师。说明你为什么找他，以及你需要什么帮助。

task: You are the Timer. Give your report from the times below. For each person, say their time and whether they finished within time.
say: Prepared speeches, five to seven minutes: James, six minutes ten seconds. Aroha, eight minutes five seconds. Table Topics, one to two minutes: Lee, one minute thirty. Priya, two minutes forty.
zh: 你是计时员。根据下面的时间做报告。逐一说出每个人用了多长时间，以及是否在规定时间内完成。

task: You are the Ah-Counter. Give your report from the numbers below. Keep it friendly and encouraging, and finish with a short tip.
say: Sam: um five times, ah twice. Mei: so four times, like three times. David: no filler words at all.
zh: 你是“口头禅统计员”。根据下面的数字做报告。语气友好、鼓励，最后给一个小建议。

task: You are the Grammarian. At the start of the meeting, explain your role, give the word of the day below, say what it means, and use it in a sentence.
zh: 你是语法官。在会议开始时解释你的职责，公布下面这个“每日一词”，说明它的意思，并用它造一个句子。

task: You are the Table Topics Master. Explain to the guests how Table Topics works: what happens, how long to speak, and that they can say no if they prefer.
zh: 你是即兴演讲主持人。向嘉宾解释即兴演讲环节是怎么进行的：流程是什么、讲多久，以及他们也可以选择不参加。

task: You are the Sergeant at Arms. Open the meeting: welcome everyone, ask people to switch phones to silent, point out the exits and the toilets, and hand over to the president.
zh: 你是会务官（Sergeant at Arms）。宣布会议开始：欢迎大家，请大家把手机调成静音，告诉大家出口和洗手间的位置，然后把舞台交给主席。

task: You can't do your role at next week's meeting. Message or tell another member: explain why, and politely ask if they can swap with you.
say: I'm down as Timer next Tuesday, but I have to work late.
zh: 你下周会议不能担任自己的角色了。告诉另一位会员：说明原因，并礼貌地问对方能不能和你换。

task: You are the Grammarian. Give your report from the notes below: who used the word of the day, one great phrase you heard, and one small language slip, said kindly.
say: Word of the day, resilient, used by Grace and Tom. Great phrase from Raj: a storm in a teacup. Small slip: one speaker said, he don't know.
zh: 你是语法官。根据下面的笔记做报告：谁用了每日一词、你听到的一个精彩表达，以及一个小小的语言错误（委婉地指出）。

task: You are the Toastmaster of the evening. Explain tonight's programme to the audience in one minute: the three parts of the meeting and what happens in each.
say: Tonight: two prepared speeches, Table Topics, then evaluations and reports.
zh: 你是当晚的主持人。用一分钟向观众介绍今晚的议程：会议的三个部分，以及每部分做什么。

task: You are the Toastmaster of the evening. The last speaker has just finished. Thank them, make one short positive comment on the speech, ask the Timer for the time, and introduce the next part of the meeting.
zh: 你是当晚的主持人。最后一位演讲者刚讲完。感谢他，对演讲做一句简短的正面评价，请计时员报时，然后引出会议的下一个环节。

task: You are the General Evaluator. Give a short report on the whole meeting: what went well, one thing the club could improve (for example, starting on time), and thank the team.
zh: 你是总评估员。对整场会议做一个简短的报告：哪些方面做得好，俱乐部可以改进的一点（比如准时开始），并感谢所有人。
